recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞量增加，可見多顆大小不一、部分成群的巨核細胞，旁邊有紅血球島與顆粒球前驅細胞，並夾雜一片小淋巴球聚集；形態屬非特異的高細胞性骨髓，需結合抹片空泡與 UBA1 突變判讀為 VEXAS。
features: Hypercellular marrow with residual fat spaces
Increased megakaryocytes of variable size, focally loosely clustered, some with hypolobated nuclei
Erythroid islands with round dark nuclei and expanded granulocytic precursors
Interstitial collection of small mature lymphocytes without a well-formed nodule
No sheets of blasts, granulomas or metastatic tumor
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular with trilineage hematopoiesis. Megakaryocytes are increased and variable in size, with focal loose clustering and some hypolobated forms, and erythroid islands and granulocytic precursors are expanded. A small interstitial collection of mature lymphocytes is present without a discrete lymphoid nodule. There are no sheets of blasts, granulomas, or metastatic tumor cells. In a patient with a UBA1 p.Met41Leu variant and vacuolated precursors on the aspirate, findings are consistent with the hypercellular, mildly dysplastic marrow of VEXAS syndrome.

ddx.vs: MDS shows similar hypercellularity and dysmegakaryopoiesis; UBA1 sequencing and inflammatory clinical features distinguish VEXAS.
MPNs show tight clusters of large hyperlobated or cloud-like megakaryocytes, often with reticulin fibrosis, and JAK2/CALR/MPL driver mutations.
Lymphoma forms nodular, paratrabecular or interstitial monotypic aggregates confirmed by CD20 and light chain restriction, unlike this small reactive-appearing lymphoid collection.
